snippet.text: | `melian compare misses <range\|#pr> [--reason <reason>]... [--out <path>]` | Writes one miss for each defect no Melian finding matches, the first report of its group in site order that a person judged valid with a reason `--reason` names, as a JSON array of `{ name, repo, base, head, file, lines }`, the misses file `MELIAN_EVAL_MISSES` reads. `repo` is the clone's absolute path and `name` is `<changeset>-<finding ID>`. A finding compared in several rounds comes from the last. A finding that an unattributed comparison shares with another comparison is left out and named, since nothing orders that comparison among the rounds. `--reason` takes `needs-execution`, the default, for the probing measurement; `owned-missed` for a lens's parity or goldens; and `no-owner` for a new rule or lens. Repeat it to write several. It refuses `out-of-scope`, since no lens owed such a miss, and any other word. It names on standard error each one with no lines at its compared head: no file or line, the base side, an outdated thread, or another commit. It also leaves out and names each miss the measurement tool could not place, as that tool checks it: a file the range does not change, or one missing, a link, binary or empty at the head, and lines past the file's end, since the tool refuses the whole file for one such miss. It writes nothing when no miss remains | `0`, `1` missing comparison, no miss to write, or unwritable output |
